code_review.project_type: web application — full-stack monorepo (FastAPI backend + React/Vite frontend), gallery of AI application pattern demos

existing_self_description.text: Built with Spec4 (BWS4) is a living showcase of common AI application patterns, presented as a collection of small, self-contained example apps behind a single landing page.

architecture.summary: A monorepo pairing a FastAPI backend organized by feature vertical (embeddings, rag, single_call, tools) around shared framework services (generation, embedding, storage, web_search, model_registry), with a React/Vite frontend mirroring the same per-example structure and route-based lazy-loading so each example app code-splits independently.

dependencies.name: fastapi
dependencies.purpose: REST API framework with auto-generated OpenAPI schema

dependencies.name: sqlalchemy
dependencies.purpose: ORM / data access, including pgvector cosine-distance queries

dependencies.name: pgvector
dependencies.purpose: pgvector extension bindings for vector similarity search

dependencies.name: litellm
dependencies.purpose: Unified LLM client routing to OpenRouter/Groq with fallback chains

dependencies.name: torch
dependencies.purpose: Tensor backend for sentence-transformers (CPU build pinned)

dependencies.name: plotly.js
dependencies.purpose: Scatter plot visualization for embeddings example

directory_map.role: FastAPI route handlers, one module per example app + health
SQLAlchemy models, session management, Alembic migrations
Embeddings example: placement logic, presets, service
RAG pipeline: chunking, retrieval, citations, dataset, prompts
Shared framework services: generation, embedding, storage, web search, model registry
Tool-use example app: agent loop, prompts
Typed API clients + TanStack Query hooks, one pair per example app
Per-example UI feature modules (embeddings, rag, single-call, tooluse)
Route-level screens per example plus landing, health, coming-soon

env_vars.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for OpenRouter, used by the shared LiteLLM model registry

env_vars.name: EXA_API_KEY
env_vars.purpose: API key for Exa web search, used by the tool-use example's function-calling loop

env_vars.name: SENTRY_DSN
env_vars.purpose: Enables backend Sentry error tracking / observability spans; no-ops when unset

env_vars.name: VITE_SENTRY_DSN
env_vars.purpose: Enables frontend Sentry error tracking; unset disables initialization

env_vars.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME
env_vars.purpose: Overrides the sentence-transformers model pre-downloaded at build time (defaults to all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

api_surface.summary: Returns curated text examples at their projected 2D coordinates
Places visitor-submitted text on the fixed 2D embeddings plot

ui_summary.styling: Tailwind CSS, class-based light/dark theming persisted via localStorage
ui_summary.routing: Client-side routing with per-example lazy-loaded chunks, configured in frontend/src/routes.tsx

test_coverage.coverage_summary: Backend has extensive pytest coverage — 23 test files under backend/tests/ spanning embeddings, single-call, RAG (generation, retrieval, citations, chunking), tool-use/tool-agent, model registry, observability, shared services, usage-limit windows, and health. Frontend ships vitest + @testing-library devDependencies and a test script, but no frontend test files were visible in the sampled directory listing.

incomplete_or_dead_code: No Python linter, formatter, or type checker (ruff/black/mypy) is declared in pyproject.toml despite a documented 'Google-style docstring' convention — backend has no automated style/type enforcement.

change_risks.risk: Hand-curated free-tier OpenRouter/Groq model slug chains rot as providers retire free models; README explicitly warns these require periodic manual refresh.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Treat model-registry chain updates as recurring maintenance; verify slugs against provider changelogs before relying on a chain in a new phase.

security_observations: API is unauthenticated by design for a public demo; CORS is restricted to exactly one configured origin (settings.cors_origin) rather than '*', and per-UTC-day usage caps are enforced server-side before any paid provider call to prevent quota drain from anonymous traffic.

render.yaml pre-downloads the sentence-transformers embedding model (~88 MB) at build time specifically to avoid cold-start latency and Hugging Face's unauthenticated rate limit on Render's shared egress IPs
